# ttt2 - ReXGlue recompiled project (host executable). Generated by `rexglue init` (SDK 0.10.0) and edited.
#
# This builds only with the ReXGlue SDK available (REXSDK_DIR or an installed package) and with the
# player's own game files in recomp/game/ for the codegen step. See docs/DEVELOPMENT.md.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(ttt2 LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

include(generated/rexglue.cmake)

set(TTT2_SOURCES
    src/main.cpp
    src/ttt2_app.cpp
    src/stub_counter.cpp
    src/kernel_overrides.cpp
    src/runtime_exports.cpp
    src/boot_monitor.cpp
    src/kernel_clock.cpp
    src/frame_monitor.cpp
    src/pm4_stats.cpp
    src/io_overrides.cpp
    src/wait_overrides.cpp
    src/milestone_overrides.cpp
    src/input/input_core.cpp
)

if(WIN32)
    add_executable(ttt2 WIN32 ${TTT2_SOURCES})
else()
    add_executable(ttt2 ${TTT2_SOURCES})
endif()

# GPU_PLUGINS xenos: the Xenos GPU emulation plugin is loaded at run time from the executable's
# folder (the SDK's loader looks nowhere else), so stage it there; Ttt2App::OnPreSetup selects it
# unless --gpu_plugin says otherwise.
rexglue_setup_target(ttt2 GPU_PLUGINS xenos)

# The host's export wrappers (src/runtime_exports.cpp) find the runtime's own functions with
# dlsym(RTLD_NEXT) on Linux and macOS.
target_link_libraries(ttt2 PRIVATE ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})

# The SDK stages its runtime DLL next to the host on Windows and macOS only; do the same on Linux
# so the $ORIGIN rpath it sets resolves and the build folder runs as is (CI boots it headless).
if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
    add_custom_command(TARGET ttt2 POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different $<TARGET_FILE:rex::runtime> $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:ttt2>
        VERBATIM)
endif()

# rex/rex_app.h pulls in the SDK's ImGui-based UI headers; in a source-tree build (REXSDK_DIR) the
# ImGui target is not propagated to consumers, so link it explicitly for the include directories.
if(TARGET imgui::imgui)
    target_link_libraries(ttt2 PRIVATE imgui::imgui)
endif()
